description: A React component for a detailed Usage Page dashboard, displaying user activity, spend metrics, and various breakdowns with charts and tables.

methods.name: getAllTags
methods.description: Fetches all tags and sets them in state.

methods.name: fetchUserSpendData
methods.description: Fetches user spend data over selected date range, using aggregated or paginated API calls.

methods.name: handleDateChange
methods.description: Handles date range change, updates state and triggers data fetch.

methods.name: getTopModels
methods.description: Calculates top models by spend from user spend data.

methods.name: getTopModelGroups
methods.description: Calculates top model groups by spend.

methods.name: getTopKeys
methods.description: Calculates top API keys by spend.

methods.name: getModelActivityData
methods.description: Processes user spend data to extract model-specific activity metrics.
